title.narrative: Technical Assistance for Economic Crimes - Liberia

description.narrative: Assist the Government of Liberia (GoL) in resolving impediments to effective implementation of its anti-money laundering and countering the financing of terrorism (AML/CFT) regime. Capacity building activities are focused, in particular, on improving the operation of the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU); financial sector supervision, with an initial emphasis on the banking sector; and financial crimes case development, including inter-agency collaboration on analysis, investigation, and prosecution of predicate crimes and associated money laundering. The interagency Financial Crimes Working Group (FCWG), which works with the Economic Crimes Team advisors as well as independently, plays a key role in identifying and working collaboratively to address impediments.
